sql_templates.description: Query to find improving sectors and candidate stocks based on breadth and stage 2 participation.
sql_templates.name: sector_breadth_rotation_query
sql_templates.template:
SELECT sd.sector, COUNT(ss.symbol) AS stage2_count, MAX(s.relative_strength) AS max_relative_strength
FROM breadth.sector_daily sd
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ss ON sd.sector = ss.sector
WHERE sd.snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'
AND ss.stage = 'STAGE_2'
AND ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
GROUP BY sd.sector
ORDER BY stage2_count DESC, max_relative_strength DESC
LIMIT 10;
